memory_measurement: Unity Profiler.GetRuntimeMemorySizeLong in Editor; not a dedicated GPU-residency measurement
caveat: 100 instances share the same three meshes/materials/textures. Not 100 distinct building asset sets. Editor synchronous render/readback timing is not FPS. The existing pipeline shadow distance is 50m; the overview camera is more than 400m away, so this benchmark does not measure city-wide realtime shadows.
